bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis (Anna Coulling)
subject: finance

volume_price_analysis.definition: The methodology of evaluating the relationship between volume, price spread, and wicks to decode institutional smart money activity.

accumulation.definition: The phase where smart money or specialists systematically absorb supply from retail panic sellers at wholesale prices before marking up the price.

distribution.definition: The phase where smart money or specialists systematically transfer their inventory to retail buyers at inflated retail prices before marking down the price.

stopping_volume.definition: High or ultra-high volume appearing on a down-candle with a pronounced lower shadow, signaling institutional absorption that halts downward momentum.

testing.definition: A low-volume maneuver engineered by insiders to verify whether floating supply has been completely cleared before launching a markup phase.

persona.contextDescription: Volume Price Analysis (VPA), candlestick spreads, tick volume, order flow absorption, accumulation and distribution.
